column1: ## Repository Table R28. Cohort sources and ancestry composition
## Description: Counts of unique final-resource individuals by source cohort and five-category ancestry.
## Method: S1 PC classifier (calibrated kNN, 15 neighbors, first 6 PCs); all 3,188 internal Chinese cohort participants are EAS by cohort annotation.
## Interpretation: Others combines accepted AMR/MID/OCE and rejected predictions. Model probabilities are not ancestry proportions.
## Source: Same sample assignments as S2 and cohort totals as S4.
## Column 1 | Source cohort | Source cohort; All is the entire final resource.
## Column 2 | Individuals | Number of unique individuals.
## Column 3 | EUR | Number assigned to the EUR display category.
## Column 4 | AFR | Number assigned to the AFR display category.
## Column 5 | EAS | Number assigned to the EAS display category.
## Column 6 | SAS | Number assigned to the SAS display category.
## Column 7 | Others | Number assigned to the Others display category.
## Column 8 | Others AMR | Accepted AMR underlying class, displayed as Others.
## Column 9 | Others MID | Accepted MID underlying class, displayed as Others.
## Column 10 | Others OCE | Accepted OCE underlying class, displayed as Others.
## Column 11 | Others rejected | Rejected by model confidence, distance or input quality criteria; displayed as Others.
